about: Kryptobaatar (Kryptobaatar dashzevegi): no record of its colors; here a small desert mammal's, grey-brown to warm brown above, pale below.

loci.name: Size
loci.about: small to big for its kind and sex (inherited, like height in people: many genes, each a little)

loci.name: Curiosity
loci.about: aloof to curious: whether it comes to look at a player standing still nearby instead of keeping away

loci.name: Fierceness
loci.about: timid to fierce: a hunter's eagerness to hunt and to keep at a chase, a plant eater's readiness to stand its ground
